entries.name: Guild Haggler
entries.summary: Proficiency in Persuasion and +1 to Persuasion and Deception.

entries.name: Merchant's Insight
entries.summary: Once per long rest, after failing a market check, add your Wisdom modifier.

entries.name: Ring of the Silver Purse
entries.summary: Advantage on Persuasion checks. 2 charges, used before rolling.

entries.name: Coin of Fortune
entries.summary: Cast before a check: +1d6 to any Charisma check. 3 casts.

entries.name: Fey-touched Trader
entries.summary: Expertise in Investigation; a d20 of 7 or lower counts as 8 on Investigation.
